candidate.description: BIPX intermediate upgraded candidate; active development, not a final immutable release
candidate.interpretation: Evidence from different intermediate source revisions is explicitly historical and cannot combine into final-candidate approval.

observations: Independent QA visually inspected native menu, desktop gameplay and compact mobile gameplay screenshots from real browser capture.
Teal/charcoal environment and warm gold interface are cohesive; main-menu typography and hierarchy are deliberate and legible.

Environment visibly repeats simple cone-shaped trees, cross slabs and grave slabs. The avatar is visibly blocky. These remain obvious simplified/placeholder-quality forms relative to the requested AAA goal.
Compact mobile screenshot shows noticeably pixelated/soft 3D geometry under a crisp DOM overlay. Early-play screenshots are sparse and do not demonstrate dense-combat composition.
No sustained complete-play video review, animation quality review or physical-device visual review was completed.
New real-time combat VFX module and custom HDR/composite pipeline exist; source API exposes counters and bounded particle/glyph/beam pools.
Weapon-family integration test was created but has not yet run for this snapshot.

VFX author reports 21 emit types, instanced pools, surface-sampled flame and heat, flame volume, leaves, targeting rings and silhouette echoes; these are source/author reports and have not all been independently verified in gameplay.
Upstream exact rig/physical fist animation and flight feature parity are not established. A complete verified effect-source mapping and temporal visual evaluation are still pending.
Natural keyboard movement plus pointer firing changed player position and produced projectiles in desktop browser.
Actual browser touch events successfully moved and fired simultaneously in portrait and landscape. Movement stopped after touch release.
These short scenarios did not establish all weapon responsiveness, animation recovery, boss telegraph clarity, difficulty curve, or sustained combat feel.

All three natural experience scenarios passed main menu, help, options, ranking, login/start, actual movement/fire, mute, quality/reduced-motion preference persistence after reload, and solo pause/resume.
Pause froze survivalTime; closing options resumed simulation. No horizontal overflow was detected.
Desktop and touch portrait/landscape menus/HUD were captured. Death/restart, upgrade flow and exhaustive keyboard focus review remain pending in the updated interface.
390x844 portrait and874x402 landscape browser emulation used hasTouch and isMobile true, actual CDP touch drag and simultaneous firing; both passed.
No physical iOS or Android hardware test exists. Thermal behavior, OS keyboard, interruptions and Safari/Android differences remain unverified.
Native compact-mobile screenshot shows noticeable 3D pixelation; UI remains crisp.
User gestures unlocked the Web Audio context into running state and visible sound toggle changed mute state in three real browser scenarios.
Current verified audio is synthesized. User-authorized ElevenLabs effects are being generated, but no generated audio is verified as integrated at this evidence point.
No audio-output recording or listening review, clipping measurement, sustained mix review or spatial-cue judgment was performed. Context running is not audible-quality proof.
Historical90-zombie stress on pinned headless Chromium153.0.8010.12 used SwiftShader software renderer: sampled25.9fps desktop,39.4fps mobile viewport; p95 50.1ms/33.4ms.
Historical equivalent stress on installed Chrome153.0.8010.48 with Apple M5 Pro ANGLE Metal GPU: desktop144fps p95 7.7ms; mobile viewport141.8fps p95 7.7ms with2 frames over50ms, worst111.1ms.
Both historical performance suites failed strict diagnostics because the UI module was still being written; this has since been resolved for the experience suite, but stress suites must be rerun.
Current three-second natural experience samples are short observations, not sustained/per-device performance qualification. Level16 final stress and physical mobile hardware remain unverified.
Existing protocol smoke harness covers shared monster IDs, attack reward, late join and room wipe, but has not been rerun for the current candidate in this QA pass.
A new two-real-browser suite covers natural replicated input, identical authoritative monster snapshots, disconnect and fresh rejoin; it is written but not executed yet.
Reconnect with resumed identity, packet-loss behavior, simultaneous browser death/wipe, competitive abuse and prolonged sessions remain unverified.
UI includes semantic controls, help, canvas fallback, visible contrast option, motion reduction and browser zoom restriction removal.
Reduced-motion preference reached runtime and persisted across reload; actual suppression of all dynamic effects is not independently visually reviewed.
Keyboard-only focus walkthrough, measured contrast, zoom layouts, screen-reader behavior and non-color cue coverage remain pending.
All three completed natural experience runs recorded no page errors, console errors, failed requests or HTTP errors and no source changes within each scenario.
HTTP probes passed public files, protected env/git/server/tools/docs/output paths, encoded traversal, malformed URI400, GET/HEAD and invalid POST405; response bodies were discarded.
Broad combat suite previously stopped at a renamed leaderboard column assertion; semantic test updated from Level to Level-or-Nivel but full rerun pending.
Not all automated suites currently pass on the same immutable candidate; long play, repeated restart and final asset/audio lifecycle validation remain pending.

openDefects: Visual art still uses obvious repeated simple geometry and blocky avatar relative to requested AAA quality.
Mobile 3D rendering visibly pixelated in inspected screenshot.
Complete upstream VFX applicability/parity and final gameplay coverage not established.
Physical iOS/Android, final audio listening, long-play reliability and complete accessibility review absent.
Final immutable candidate and all automated suites passing together not established.

directReviews.visual: partial screenshot inspection only, details above
directReviews.independentReviewer: QA Codex agent; not Jev; no numerical quality score assigned
